title: Airport Flex Park lender appraisal
summary: Airport Flex Park · Prepared for Desert Mountain Bank

evidence.quote: The as-is market value of Airport Flex Park as of December 31, 2025 is $7,200,000, equal to the contract price.
This appraisal was prepared for Desert Mountain Bank for loan underwriting.
A loan of $4,980,000 is 69.2% of that value.
